column1: Reported road casualties by road user type and local authority, Great Britain, 10 years up to 2025
This worksheet contains one table. Some cells refer to notes which can be found on the notes worksheet.

The local authority breakdowns presented in this workbook are based on the geography as of the latest respective year's publication date. The reported coordinates of the collision are used to determine which local authority a collision would have occurred in.
Filters are active in row 5 and may hide some data. To turn off all filters select the ‘Data’ ribbon then ‘Filter’ button  or use [Ctrl, Shift, L].
